- config.ts (logic): Contains application configuration including network settings, database connection strings, and other constants. Uses environment variables for sensitive information.
- database.ts (api): Manages database operations. Responsible for connecting to the database and executing queries on media files, streaming sessions, and user data.
- media_service.ts (logic): Handles the business logic for managing media files. Can include methods for uploading, organizing, and retrieving media data.
- user_service.ts (logic): Handles user authentication, authorization, and profile management. Includes methods for registering new users, logging in, and updating profiles.
- stream_service.ts (logic): Manages streaming sessions. Includes methods to initiate and terminate streams, handle user connections, and manage playback settings.
- connection_service.ts (api): Handles network connections. Includes methods to detect available devices on the network and establish streaming sessions.
- home_screen.tsx (ui): The main user interface for the home screen. Displays a list of media files and streams available devices to stream to.
- connection_screen.tsx (ui): The user interface for managing streaming connections. Displays a list of active streams and allows users to initiate new sessions.
- styles.css (ui): Contains global styles for the application. Defines common UI elements like buttons, text, and backgrounds.
- types.ts (logic): Defines types and interfaces used throughout the application. Helps enforce data structure consistency across different parts of the codebase.
- server.ts (api): Sets up the server using an Express.js framework. Defines routes and middleware for handling incoming requests.
- validator.ts (logic): Contains validation logic to ensure data integrity and error handling. Uses Joi for schema validation across different layers.
- logger.ts (logic): Handles logging throughout the application. Outputs logs to systemd journal for easy monitoring and debugging.
- routes.ts (api): Defines API routes for the application. Includes endpoints for media management, user authentication, and stream control.
- middleware.ts (api): Handles middleware functions for incoming requests. Includes authentication checking and other pre-request processing.
- package.json (logic): Metadata for the project including dependencies, scripts, and configuration settings. Used by npm to manage package installations and scripts.
- tsconfig.json (logic): Compiler options used by TypeScript for compiling the project. Defines configurations like target language, module system, and source map generation.
- tslint.json (logic): Configuration file for TypeScript linting rules to enforce code quality and consistency.
- jest.config.js (logic): Configuration file for Jest test runner including settings like coverage threshold and transform rules.
- systemd.service (logic): Systemd service file for packaging the application as a .deb file. Defines how the app is started and stopped on the system.
